notable_features.text: Italian is a Romance language closely related to Latin, often considered one of the least changed Romance languages from its Latin roots. It follows a basic subject-verb-object word order and has a relatively large phoneme inventory of 70 sounds. The standard language is based on literary Florentine Tuscan, and it is spoken by tens of millions of people as a native or second language.
